controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 328964820, checkpoint-scoped GraphQL reads confirm the shared Treasury (initialSharedVersion 758887726), embedded DenyCapV2 with allow_global_pause=true, and MetadataCap. TreasuryCap<SUI_USDE> 0xae5039079b0cf2bb7694c24b411ea9fc24a1a59f602ca90b0ba2b2095da54bda remains owned by the Treasury's inner dynamic-field wrapper 0x19a91d61e89f99f405e780b372765ea356a552406f92dc2995f9603228c20c21. Treasury configuration records hourly max_mint=10000000000000 and daily max_mint=100000000000000 in six-decimal units; these operational limits are mutable, not an immutable supply ceiling.

UpgradeCap 0x764653924d7bc3b889809de7ca077f5dd69ec378cb5d52be448c15613a5116c8 is AddressOwner-owned by the same address, with policy=0, version=3 and package 0xb81bd7d3d18ed48c31286ac66c2dc7f301a8b57227130de0dbddd5f7aa3a0ccc.
